_doc: LongBench v1 RAG smoke: 3 subtasks spanning categories — multifieldqa_en (single-doc QA / F1), hotpotqa (multi-doc QA / F1), gov_report (summarization / ROUGE). FIELD-BY-FIELD NOTES (the other longbench configs reference this file). INSTANCE CONVENTION: each instance id is a LongBench v1 HF subset name (THUDM/LongBench); one instance == one subtask. The loader (agent_bench/benchmarks/longbench/loader.py) materializes instance_data per subtask with instance_data['benchmark']=='longbench', off which the driver auto-selects LongBenchHarness. EVALUATION MODE: RAG-only — for each example the harness ingests that example's `context` document into the ClawRAG skill (clawhub.ai/2dogsandanerd/clawrag, MCP server reachable at localhost:8080) and the OpenClaw agent answers via retrieval; NO full-context baseline. SCORING: LongBench's native per-task metric (qa_f1 for *qa, rouge for summarization, classification/retrieval/count/code_sim for the rest), averaged per subtask. MODEL: not set here — choose existing local vLLM Qwen via --model/--serving (profiles/models + profiles/serving). repo_mapping is SWE-bench-specific but RunConfig.compute_run_id requires it for deterministic hashing — dummy values fine, LongBenchHarness ignores them. container_image is a schema-required placeholder (UNUSED): the ClawRAG service + OpenClaw sandbox are wired by the harness, not this field. STATUS: this is the dataset-selection layer; loader, LongBenchHarness, harness config, and driver dispatch are implemented in the migrated package.
